name: button-swapper
long_description:
This homebrew allows you to swap X/O button assignment.
On Japanese Vitas O is confirm and X is cancel, while the rest of the world is X confirm, O cancel.
Please note that using this homebrew is different from swapping X/O in Accessibility settings => Button Assignment. This homebrew "properly" swaps the buttons, without using Accessibility settings.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
